description: Gives apps on Windows access to passkeys, so that signing in with a passkey works in apps and in a remote session (Windows App, Azure Virtual Desktop) without the user having to turn on the privacy setting themselves. Baseline assignment: all devices. Source: Own baseline — OMA-URI ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/Privacy/LetAppsAccessPasskeys = 1 (Force allow), Policy CSP Privacy..
